missimo ireland: world mission sunday takes place this weekend . this collection will replace the usual share collection. october and world mission sunday is a time for the faithful of the world to show their appreciation towards the work of overseas missionaries. please call missio ireland on (01) 497 2035 or go to

for further information. eucharistic adoration: eucharistic adoration will continue each monday after the 10.00 a.m. mass except on bank holidays. church shop/repository: the church repository/shop is open every tuesday and thursday morning after 10.00 a.m. mass and after 11.00 a.m. mass on sundays. a good selection of items is available. mass intentions: we include up to 5 mass intentions in the announcements at week-end masses (saturday evening and sunday morning). mass intentions should be notified to the sacristy for inclusion at least 3 months in advance to avoid disappointment. material for weekly bulletin: please note all material for publication in the weekly bulletin must reach the parish ofïce by 10.00 a.m. on thursday morning.

“help shape the future of our parish community: we are seeking enthusiastic volunteers to help serve in various church activities. your time and talents can make a real difference! in particular, we need people who have an interest in being involved in the centenary preparations for 2028, care of creation in our church environs, and being part of a wonderful new initiative a marino parish orchestra! forms are available on the pew with biros! thank you “ parish lotto fundraiser: this week’s winning numbers in our parish lotto fundraiser are available at the back of the church and on our website. – your commitment and continued support contribute greatly to the upkeep of our parish church and grounds and is very much appreciated. to join our fundraiser, visit our website at

altar list of the dead: the altar list of the dead envelopes will be distributed during the coming week to all households in the parish. ‘koins for kids’ : all coins and notes old, new, damaged including non-euro currency will be gratefully accepted and can be dropped into the sacristy. full details on church notice board.
pray er for the sick: please pray for all our deceased relatives and friends listed at the back of the church.
